title: Volvo FM Low Profile High Tensile Alloy FUPS Bullbar #32
description: Volvo FM heavy duty FUPS high tensile low profile aluminium Bullbar. Custom built with mesh for maximum cab protection. Dual tow pins and heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate. Custom driving light mounts can be fitted to customer specification. Additional headlight protection bars. Provision for factory fitted radar. Combination Indicator/Park Lights in main channel protected by polycarbonate covers. The low profile allows for the cab front panel to be opened without dropping the Bullbar.
